verdict.rationale: Zero's own MCP.md documents an official ZeroMCP server that exposes a broad toolset to connected agents: reading and listing threads, composing, sending and drafting, deleting, managing labels, bulk archive and delete, AI Q&A, and Perplexity search. Connecting is limited, though: OAuth is only 'coming soon', so users must manually copy a browser session cookie into the Authorization header. missing for 10: OAuth or another production-grade agent auth flow, client setup instructions for specific MCP hosts, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: You can connecto ZeroMCP using two methods: 1. Better Auth session token 2. OAuth (Coming soon)
Copy the session cookie from your browser cookies and place it into the Authorization header.
Get email threads by ID - List emails in specific folders - Create and send new emails - Create email drafts - Send existing drafts - Delete emails
